prompt-logging-hook.name: Prompt Logging Hook
prompt-logging-hook.description: UserPromptSubmit hook that auto-logs every developer prompt to prompts.jsonl (author, timestamp, prompt text) for hackathon tracking. Registered in .claude/settings.json; delegates to scripts/log-prompt.mjs.

checkout-authorized.name: Checkout Authorized
checkout-authorized.description: Per-user spending-policy check (per-tx/daily USDC caps) plus an explicit !checkout-confirmed signal from the user for amounts above the auto-approve threshold. Runs after ^authenticated, before any wallet transfer is submitted.

webhook-signature-verified.name: Webhook Signature Verified
webhook-signature-verified.description: Verifies Circle's X-Circle-Signature / X-Circle-Key-Id headers. Used instead of ^authenticated on webhook routes, which have no user session.
